license_required.quote: The board shall grant a certificate to any applicant who meets the requirements of good moral character, education, examination, and experience requirements

issuing_authority.quote: the South Dakota Board of Accountancy established pursuant to this chapter

name.quote: the South Dakota Board of Accountancy established pursuant to this chapter

type.quote: the South Dakota Board of Accountancy established pursuant to this chapter

moral_character_required.quote: Good moral character for purposes of §36-20B-13 means lack of a history of dishonest or felonious acts

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or graduate degree in accounting
degree_required.quote: graduation from an accredited college or university with a baccalaureate or a graduate degree in accounting, or the satisfactory completion of a course of study which the board has determined to be substantially the equivalent of an accounting degree

required.quote: An applicant for initial issuance of a certificate under this chapter shall show that the applicant has acquired one year of experience

duration.quote: the applicant has acquired one year of experience

kind.value: accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills
kind.quote: providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.quote: The examination required to be passed as a condition for the granting of a certificate shall be held at least annually and shall test the applicant's knowledge of the subjects of accounting, auditing, and such other related subjects as the board may specify

exams.name: Ethics examination
exams.quote: An applicant shall pass an examination covering the rules of ethics and professional conduct promulgated by the board

interval_years.quote: A certificate shall be initially issued, and renewed, for a period of one year

required.quote: For renewal of a certificate under this chapter, a licensee shall participate in a program of learning designed to maintain professional competency

hours_per_period.quote: A licensee shall complete one hundred twenty hours of continuing education in each three-year renewal period

period_years.quote: one hundred twenty hours of continuing education in each three-year renewal period

available.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to an applicant who does not qualify for reciprocity under the substantial equivalency standard provided in this chapter but who holds a certificate, license, or permit issued by another state

requirements.value: Substantial equivalency standard or four years of experience after passing examination within ten years preceding application
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to any applicant who obtains from the board of the other state verification that such applicant's qualifications are substantially equivalent to the CPA licensure requirements of this chapter

exists.quote: the South Dakota Board of Accountancy established pursuant to this chapter

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants
national_association.quote: the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

regulatory_model.quote: The board shall grant a certificate to any applicant who meets the requirements of good moral character, education, examination, and experience requirements

credential_type.quote: Certificate issued pursuant to this chapter, a permit issued pursuant to this chapter, or a registration pursuant to this chapter

is_mandatory.quote: No person other than a licensee or an individual granted practice privileges under the provisions of §36-20B-66 or 36-20B-67 may issue a report on financial statements of any person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or offer to render or render any attest or compilation service

title_protection.quote: A person who does not hold a valid certificate or has not been granted practice privileges under the provisions of §36-20B-66 or 36-20B-67 may not use or assume the title, certified public accountant, the abbreviation, CPA, or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that such person is a certified public accountant

scope_protection.quote: No person other than a licensee or an individual granted practice privileges under the provisions of §36-20B-66 or 36-20B-67 may issue a report on financial statements of any person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or offer to render or render any attest or compilation service

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew a certificate, license, or permit in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew a certificate, license, or permit to engage in the practice of public accountancy in any other state for any cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal or to report changes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, on the part of a holder of a certificate, license, or permit under this chapter or registration under this chapter, or of a certificate, license or permit issued by another state, to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of such certificate, license, permit, or registration or to report changes to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or repeated acts of negligence in performance of services or in filing tax returns
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or repeated acts of negligence in the performance of services as a licensee or individual granted practice privileges under the provisions of §36-20B-66 or 36-20B-67 or in the filing or failure to file one's own income tax returns

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter or rules, or violation of professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this chapter or rule, promulgated by the board pursuant to chapter 1-26, or violation of professional standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board pursuant to chapter 1-26

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime involving dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, or of any crime an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of the United States, of this state, or of any other state if the acts involved would have constituted a crime under the laws of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a certificate, license, or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a certificate, license, or permit or privilege issued under this chapter or prior law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services while a licensee or individual granted practice privileges under the provisions of §36-20B-66 or 36-20B-67

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or verification, in support of an application for a certificate, registration, or permit filed by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty or repeated acts of negligence in the performance of peer reviews
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty or repeated acts of negligence in the performance of peer reviews

definition_quote.value: attest means providing the following services: (1) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); (2) Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); (3) Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); (4) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Auditing Standards of the Public Company Auditing Oversight Board (PCAOB); and (5) Any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with SSAE
definition_quote.quote: attest means providing the following services: (1) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); (2) Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); (3) Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); (4) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Auditing Standards of the Public Company Auditing Oversight Board (PCAOB); and (5) Any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with SSAE

methods_authorized.quote: providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills

attest_services_types.quote: attest means providing the following services: (1) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); (2) Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); (3) Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); (4) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Auditing Standards of the Public Company Auditing Oversight Board (PCAOB); and (5) Any examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with SSAE

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Compilation, providing a service to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) that is presenting in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management (owners) without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements

education_semester_hours_required.quote: at least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education

ethics_exam_required.quote: An applicant shall pass an examination covering the rules of ethics and professional conduct promulgated by the board

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: an individual whose principal place of business is not in this state who holds a valid certificate or license as a certified public accountant from any state which the board has verified to be in substantial equivalence with the CPA licensure requirements of this chapter is presumed to have qualifications substantially equivalent to requirements of this state and shall have all the privileges of certificate holders and licensees of this chapter without the need to obtain a certificate or permit under this chapter. Notwithstanding any other provision of law, an individual who offers or renders professional services under this section, whether in person, or by mail, telephone, or electronic means, shall be granted practice privileges in this state, and no notice, fee, or other submission is required of the individual

value: consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
agree to comply with this chapter and the board's rules
cease offering or rendering professional services if license from home state is no longer valid
consent to appointment of home state board as agent for service of process
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: Any licensee of another state who exercises the practice privilege provided in §36-20B-66 or 36-20B-67 and the firm, if any, which employs that licensee hereby simultaneously consents, as a condition of the grant of this privilege, to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board, and agrees to comply with this chapter and the board's rules. If the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual shall cease offering or rendering professional services in this state, both individually and on behalf of a firm

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual who has been granted practice privileges under the provisions of §36-20B-66 or 36-20B-67 who performs for any entity with its home office in this state any of the following services: (1) Any financial statement audit or other engagements to be performed in accordance with Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); (2) Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards For Attestation Engagements (SSAE); or (3) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) auditing standards; shall do so only through a firm which has obtained a permit

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a majority of the owners of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights, are holders of a certificate and are licensed in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Firms may include nonlicensee owners. However, the firms shall be controlled by the majority vote of owners who are holders of a certificate and who are licensed in some state

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board may, by rule promulgated pursuant to chapter 1-26, require, on either a uniform or a random basis, as a condition of renewal of firm permits pursuant to this chapter, that an applicant undergo peer review

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: Any certificate holder who performs compilation services for the public other than through a CPA firm shall undergo, no more frequently than once every three years, as a condition for renewal of a certificate, a peer review

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: any peer review process be operated and any documents maintained in a manner designed to preserve confidentiality, and that neither the board nor any third party, other than the oversight body, may have access to documents furnished or generated in the course of the review

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Rules defining active and inactive status of both certificate and public accountant license holders who are not practicing public accountancy

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm which does not have an office in this state may perform services described in subdivision 36-20B-1(5) or subdivision 36-20B-2(2) for a client residing in or having a home office in this state and may use the title CPAs, CPA firm, PAs, or PA firm without a permit issued under this chapter only if: (1) The firm has the qualifications described in §§36-20B-33 and 36-20B-36; and (2) The firm performs the services through an individual with practice privileges

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: all attest and compilation services rendered in this state are under the charge of a person holding a valid certificate issued under this chapter or the corresponding provision of prior law or some other state

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any individual licensee or individual with practice privileges under the provisions of §36-20B-66 or 36-20B-67 who is responsible for supervising attest or compilation services and signs or authorizes another individual to sign the accountant's report on behalf of the firm shall meet the experience requirements set out in the professional standards for the services

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: A nonlicensee may prepare financial statements and issue nonattest transmittals or information thereon which do not purport to be in compliance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS)

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The provisions of this chapter do not apply to any person or firm holding a certification, designation, degree, or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder thereof to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in such country, whose activities in this state are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of, or business entities of, the country in which the person holds such entitlement, who performs no attest or compilation services and who issues no reports with respect to the financial statements of any other persons, firms, or governmental units in this state

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter is sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order, or conviction, respectively, without evidence of a general course of conduct

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms failing to comply with the provisions of this chapter due to changes in firm ownership, after receiving or renewing a permit, shall take immediate corrective action to return the firm to compliance. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take corrective action as specified by rule promulgated pursuant to chapter 1-26

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any firm with an office in this state performing attest services as defined in §36-20B-2
